global_stiffness.note: Static Euler (pinned) is a conservative lower bound on capacity; Beal follower-thrust free-free ~109.9 EI/L^2 an optimistic reference. The true limit couples thrust-vector control and elastic modes (Phase III).

thermal.blade_backbone_K: inside a two-faced 1800 K emitting blade the backbone sees hot sheet on both sides: ~1650-1800 K unless it is moved to the root band or wrapped in refractory multifoil

standoff_W.note: two-stage stand-off: YSZ pad 1990->900 K (k 2.2, 20 cm2, 40 mm) then Inconel flexure 900->350 K (k 20, 3 cm2, 250 mm)

thermal.ship_growth_note: free growth over the 280 m thrust ring to shield span for a 150 K change (yard ~293 K to shadowed ~150 K)

magnetic.rule: No ferromagnetic structure where |grad B| > ~1e-3 T/m (force density > 1.35 kN/m3, ~170 N per 100 kg of steel); break conductive loops with insulating joints (CN-12) where dB/dt > ~1 T/s.

rings.latch_note: Spin-down/lock happens before thrust (operating_rules.habitat): latch loads are the axial inertial share plus residual-momentum capture (0.1 % H in 10 s: ~5 kN m), not the spin torque.

calibration.note: tankage grows with propellant (0.15 of propellant mass, calibrated against ISSA F1 nominal); mission delta-v fixed

concept_mass.note: PROTOTYPE first-order items: 12-node ring + 8 m transition (~4-fold to 3-fold out-of-plane ring bending ~10 MN m at the design thrust, Ti chords), bypass collar (3 girders r 33-35 m, X 72-116, ~16 MN of tank-farm and Brow load at flight), Brow keels (125 t of shield + Eye), casing (~10,000 m2 at ~3 kg/m2 panels + straps). Ranges +-50 %.
